correspondences.notes: EGI .raw is not a BIDS EEG format, so it is not mapped; convert to EDF, BDF, BrainVision or EEGLAB first.

brainlife.desc: Raw EEG from an EGI (Geodesic/Philips) net in EGI simple binary .raw format, stored as a file named 'eeg'.
brainlife.name: neuro/eeg/egi
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Raw EGI EEG input for conversion to MNE raw.

**Not for:** EGI .mff folders; the converter reads the .raw format. Direct BIDS export: EGI .raw is not a BIDS EEG format.

**BIDS:** eeg/eeg (partial)

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 1 App.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.eeg.egi.json

files.desc: EGI simple binary (.raw) EEG recording, stored without extension.
Channel names, types, units and status.

identifying_risks: Recording dates and free-text fields in the header, markers or events.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level EEG without standard identity fields, linkable through a participant code.
sharing_cautions: Check header and event text for names and dates before sharing.
tier_conditions: Tier 3 if the EGI header, events or sidecars name the participant or give exact dates.

inputs_of.purpose: converts EGI .raw EEG to MNE raw FIF
